title: crumbkit/schemas-list/v1
description: The JSON documents that the tool prints, with a description of each.

cut.description: Present when the output budget cut the result short, so data holds only its first rows.

budget.description: The most bytes that the run printed on standard output.

code.description: The over-budget code, in the tool's spelling.

data.description: The rows of the page, up to the limit.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

total.description: The number of rows that matched, of which data holds one page. It is absent when the tool did not count a source that holds more rows.

truncated.description: True when the document leaves out rows that matched, because of the limit or the output budget, and false when data holds every row.

SchemaRow.description: One JSON document that the tool prints, or a file format that users write.

commands.description: The command lines that print the document. It is empty for the failure document, which every command prints when it fails with --json, and for a file format.

description.description: What the document holds, in one line.

form.description: stream when a command prints the document as a stream, one document on each line as each row arrives, and document when a command prints it once or it is a file format.

id.description: The document's id, such as `shelf/books-list/v1`, which `schemas show` takes.

kind.description: output when a command prints the document with its schema id, unwrapped when a command prints it without the envelope that holds its schema id, and file when it is a file format that users write and no command prints.
